verdict.rationale: Text was extracted from the public guidance pages on www.twc.texas.gov (homepage, register-tax, unemployment-tax), and probes against that host returned ordinary HTTP 404s rather than a bot wall or challenge. Together these indicate the public reading surface serves content to a keyless agent. The connection reset on apps.twc.texas.gov affects the transactional application host, not the published guidance pages. Missing for 10: an explicit probe recording HTTP 200 with the identified user agent on guidance pages, confirmation that content is server-rendered rather than a JS shell, and the readable robots.txt policy for www.twc.texas.gov.
